name: Slider
purpose: Pick a continuous value (brightness, fan speed) with the normal operating range shown as context.

elements.range: Thin band under the track marking the normal operating range (ISA-101).
elements.fill: Portion from minimum to the current value.
elements.thumb: Draggable handle; shows the pressed halo.

behavior: Drag, tap on the track, or use arrow / PageUp / PageDown / Home / End keys.
onInput fires while moving; onChange fires on release (send one device command then).

a11y.notes: aria-valuemin/max/now and aria-valuetext with the unit; aria-label is required.

lvgl.notes: lv_slider; the normal-range band is an extra drawn part.
